method: ENGINEERING fixed entrance view, no actors/encounters, invulnerability, no bob/recoil. Native zoom, tool swap/reload and lifecycle. A5/60 rifle inventory is arranged for reload. Diagnostic white geometry mask counts on-screen weapon triangles, including transparent surfaces; it is not a human visibility, aiming, ergonomics or FPS score. Diagnostic renders occur only in this fixture, never the product.
